lessons.title: Fencer: the all-rounder
lessons.text: You win by moving a unit onto the enemy base or by removing every enemy unit. The Fencer walks up to 2 steps in any direction and hits for 2. One move wins here: find it.

lessons.title: Hussar: the fast striker
lessons.text: The Hussar jumps in an L-shape and covers up to 3 hexes, but has no armor. Speed is its weapon: look for the base it can reach in one jump.

lessons.title: Knight: the diagonal rider
lessons.text: The Knight moves along six diagonal lines, up to 3 hexes. Check which of its lines ends on the enemy base.

lessons.title: Tanker: the wall
lessons.text: The Tanker has armor 4 but moves only 1 hex and attacks for 1. The base is one step away: the hard part is knowing which unit is the one that gets there.

lessons.title: Archer: two turns
lessons.text: The Archer shoots 2 hexes away but moves only 1. Now you have 2 turns: the first move sets up the second, and the enemy answers in between.

lessons.title: Oracle: a support piece
lessons.text: The Oracle has no attack and no armor, so it never wins a fight, but it still occupies space and can go where it is safe. Plan both turns.

lessons.title: Oracle: Swap
lessons.text: The Oracle can swap places with a friendly unit within range 2 (not while an enemy is adjacent to it). Swapping teleports a strong piece forward.

lessons.title: Think two moves ahead
lessons.text: Not every first move that looks good works: the enemy replies in between. Only one first move forces the win.

lessons.title: Three turns
lessons.text: The enemy has three chances to answer. Count the turns it needs to stop you, then find the line that is faster.
